scope: Local synthetic SDK fixtures, trusted sidebar input; not the user laptop or production database. No runtime correction applied. No merge or deployment.
measurementLimits: Visible is a two-frame paint opportunity estimate.
Responsive is a tracked-work and event-loop probe, not a guarantee of full application readiness.
CDP metrics include an additional 200 ms observation tail and may include unrelated scheduled work.
Nested instrumented functions, long frames and browser metrics overlap.
CPU profiles are sampled over the whole navigation sequence.
4x CPU throttling and synthetic data are stress conditions, not a model of the user laptop.
